QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Trade] Calling the Kettle Crazy
QuestInfo.0: You got a request to deliver some trade goods, and the pay seems to be good!
QuestInfo.1: Mr. Do needs a new medicine kettle to make better medicine. Take one to him in Herb Town. You will have to complete 5 trades with Rosa before you can trade with Herb Town.
QuestInfo.2: You got the medicine to Mr. Do, and managed to come out with all your organs intact. Lucky day!

0.0: Hello #h0#! The merchant guild has a job for you. Do you wish to hear about it?

yes.0: There is a guy named Mr. Do in Herb Town. We received a request from him for a special Medicinal Kettle from Commerci.
yes.1: Well, I did hear that people are saying Mr. Do is not as good as he used to be...
yes.2: Okay, I will entrust the trade to you.

no.0: I guess you're busy. Come talk to me when you've got some time.

default.0: You need to finish the trade with Herb Town with the Medicinal Kettle in your possession.

quest.0: You need to finish the trade with Herb Town with the Medicinal Kettle in your possession.
